question: Daksh travels 445 km at 89 km/hr, the next 495 km at 55 km/hr and the next 250 km at 50 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Corrected to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Distance 1 (d₁) = 445 km

Speed 1 (s₁) = 89 km/hr

Distance 2 (d₂) = 495 km

Speed 2 (s₂) = 55 km/hr

Distance 3 (d₃) = 250 km

Speed 3 (s₃) = 50 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Time = Time₁ + Time₂ + Time₃

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Total Distance = d₁ + d₂ + d₃

⇒ Total Distance = 445 + 495 + 250

⇒ Total Distance = 1190 km

Time₁ = d₁ ÷ s₁

⇒ Time₁ = 445 ÷ 89

⇒ Time₁ = 5 hours

Time₂ = d₂ ÷ s₂

⇒ Time₂ = 495 ÷ 55

⇒ Time₂ = 9 hours

Time₃ = d₃ ÷ s₃

⇒ Time₃ = 250 ÷ 50

⇒ Time₃ = 5 hours

Total Time = Time₁ + Time₂ + Time₃

⇒ Total Time = 5 + 9 + 5

⇒ Total Time = 19 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 1190 ÷ 19

⇒ Average Speed = 62.63 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
